issuer.summary: f(x) Protocol (AladdinDAO), the same issuer as fxUSD. September 22 research recorded operation since 2023, $134.3M protocol TVL and two listed audits; these are historical observations. Wrapper code match does not establish full-system audit coverage.
facts: Identical issuer to fxUSD — same score, same audits, same disclosure record. These are not independent issuer assessments.
OpenZeppelin f(x) v2 audit includes SavingFxUSD in scope BY NAME, and the deployed implementation matches that commit exactly.
⚠️ The audit does NOT cover the ProxyAdmin, the TimelockController or privileged-role configuration. No audit coverage of the authority axis.
Bug bounty present, self-hosted, Critical to $500,000.
Public matching audit coverage for the later Ethereum pool rework has not been established; shared control means fxUSD and fxSAVE are not independent counterparties.
